answer: Histories are stored in willow, checked in pearl, and ferrous reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1825 identities would post 1860 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
